# Addanapp: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-20 · code a285435a2153 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Montréal software consultancy for web apps, admin panels, client portals and data platforms. AI-accelerated, human-validated, fixed quotes. Pay for results.
**Live:** https://addanapp.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/addanapp · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/addanapp/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py addanapp` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Estimator** `#estimate`: client_code/estimate.py (pure, also imported by server api_public.submit_lead); prices only
  from tools/seo_pages/pricing.json. Pages/Estimate keeps the address in step with history.replaceState (no hashchange).
- **Sign-off records**: server_code/signoff.py + table signoffs; guard in api_admin.admin_update_request (status review);
  Components/SignoffCard, Dialogs/SignOff (consultant), Dialogs/AcceptDelivery (client, also the sample's demo).
- **Locked quotes / change orders**: server_code/quotes.py + table change_orders; lock check in update_request_as;
  admin_send_change_order / admin_cancel_change_order in api_admin; client actions approve_change / decline_change.
- Both new tables are read through guards (quotes.table(), signoff.table()) so the live app works before the Schema
  Mismatch is accepted. Styles: theme/assets/trust.css.
<!-- /NOTES -->

- **app_jobs**: client→users, kind:str, key:str, args:obj, status:str, created:dt, started:dt, finished:dt, result:obj, error:str, by→users

- **error_log**: when:dt, source:str, kind:str, message:str, traceback:str, page:str, session:str, user→users
- **leads**: name:str, email:str, company:str, kind:str, budget:str, message:str, status:str, source:str, created:dt · used in api_admin, api_client, api_public

- **signoffs**: request→requests, reviewer→users, checks:obj, criteria:obj, tests:num, note:str, client_criteria:obj, created:dt, accepted:dt · used in signoff
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, remembered_logins:obj, signed_up:dt, email_confirmation_key:str, name:str, company:str, phone:str, color:str, role:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, email_notifications:bool, created:dt, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, lang:str · used in api_admin, api_apps, apps_sync, common, seed
